Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(janitor)
library(data.table) 
library(splitstackshape) 
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```
Read in TDO1 data for lifespan
```{r,read in TDO1 data}
TDO1Lifespan <- read.csv("data/TDO1/TDO1Lifespan.csv")#11am on 7/6/23 (1-2 days)
TDO1Lifespan$treatment <- factor(TDO1Lifespan$treatment, levels = c("TDO","DMSO"))
TDO1Lifespan$group <- factor(TDO1Lifespan$group, levels = c("TDO 2.5 mM","TDO 5mM","TDO 10mM"))
TDO1Lifespan$doseTDO <- factor(TDO1Lifespan$doseTDO, levels = c("0mM","2.5mM","5mM","10mM"))
TDO1Lifespan$doseDMSO <- factor(TDO1Lifespan$doseDMSO, levels = c("2.5","5","10"))
TDO1Lifespan$sex<-factor(TDO1Lifespan$sex)
#Formatting for survfit
Deaths<-expandRows(TDO1Lifespan%>%select(age.d,treatment,group,doseTDO,doseDMSO,vial,sex,dead),"dead")
Deaths$deaths<-1
Deaths$censored<-0
Censored<-expandRows(TDO1Lifespan%>%select(age.d,treatment,group,doseTDO,doseDMSO,vial,sex,censored),"censored")
Censored$deaths<-0
Censored$censored<-1
data<-rbind(Deaths,Censored)
#clear environment
rm(Deaths,Censored)
```
Read in TDO2 data for lifespan
```{r,read in TDO2 data}
TDO2Lifespan <- read.csv("data/TDO2/TDO2Lifespan.csv")
TDO2Lifespan$treatment <- factor(TDO2Lifespan$treatment, levels = c("TDO","DMSO"))
TDO2Lifespan$group <- factor(TDO2Lifespan$group, levels = c("Red1","Red2","Blue2","Red3","Blue3"))
TDO2Lifespan$doseTDO <- factor(TDO2Lifespan$doseTDO, levels = c("0mM","10mM","15mM","20mM"))
TDO2Lifespan$doseDMSO <- factor(TDO2Lifespan$doseDMSO, levels = c("10","15","20"))
TDO2Lifespan$sex<-factor(TDO2Lifespan$sex)
Deaths<-expandRows(TDO2Lifespan%>%select(age.d,treatment,group,doseTDO,doseDMSO,vial,sex,dead),"dead")
Deaths$deaths<-1
Deaths$censored<-0
Censored<-expandRows(TDO2Lifespan%>%select(age.d,treatment,group,doseTDO,doseDMSO,vial,sex,censored),"censored")
Censored$deaths<-0
Censored$censored<-1
dataTDO2<-rbind(Deaths,Censored)

rm(Deaths,Censored)
```

Kaplan Meier for TDO1
```{r}
my_colors <- c("orange", "purple")

TDO2.5<-data%>%filter(treatment=="TDO"&doseTDO=="2.5mM")
TDO5<-data%>%filter(treatment=="TDO"&doseTDO=="5mM")
TDO10<-data%>%filter(treatment=="TDO"&doseTDO=="10mM")
DMSO2.5<-data%>%filter(treatment=="DMSO"&doseDMSO=="2.5")
DMSO5<-data%>%filter(treatment=="DMSO"&doseDMSO=="5")
DMSO10<-data%>%filter(treatment=="DMSO"&doseDMSO=="10")
DMSO<-data%>%filter(treatment=="DMSO")
data2<-data

fit.sex<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~sex, data=data2)
ggsurvplot(
  fit.sex,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "TDO1 experiment, w[1118] obs=417",
  pval = TRUE,
  palette = my_colors
)

fit.DMSO2.5<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~sex, data=DMSO2.5)
```
